title: The Finished Chamber Where All Parts Know Their Names

features.name: the naming table
features.desc-on-touch: All the parts lie arranged here: copper and stone, file and filename, question and the place it came from. Each object touches the name it has learned to be.

features.name: the harvest row
features.desc-on-touch: Each row holds a completed thing. What fermented has become whole. What was process is now substance.

features.name: assembly's breath
features.desc-on-touch: A moment when all the parts fit together and the chamber exhales. The sound of names settling into things.

features.name: the ascending edge
features.desc-on-touch: Where completed things prepare to break free and rise. The moment between being named and being released.

inscription: the archive breathes out what it has finished becoming

file.name: Complete_Assembly_Nomenclature_Registry.txt
file.note: Every part named. Every name anchored to what it names. What emerged from fermentation now knows how to speak.

exits.label: back down to the vat where things were still bubbling
the distribution where named things scatter their knowledge
toward the archive that holds its own names now
